'''Leia Skywalker Organa Solo''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] [[Alderaanian]] [[Gender|female]] [[Politics|politician]], [[Jedi]], and [[Alliance Military|military]] leader who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Imperial Era]] and the [[New Republic]] and [[Resistance]] in the subsequent [[New Republic Era]]. Shortly after birth on [[Polis Massa]], she was adopted into the [[House of Organa]]—the Alderaanian [[King|royal]] family—and was raised as [[Princess]] '''Leia Organa''' of [[Alderaan]], a [[planet]] in the [[Core Worlds]] known for its dedication to pacifism. The princess was raised as the daughter of [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa]] and his [[Marriage|wife]], [[Queen]] [[Breha Organa]], making her the heir to the [[Alderaanian monarchy]]. Instilled with the values of her adopted [[homeworld]], Organa devoted her life to the restoration of [[democracy]] by opposing [[Fascism|authoritarian]] regimes, such as the [[Galactic Empire]] and the [[First Order]].

[[Reproduction|Born]] in [[19 BBY]] as '''Leia Amidala Skywalker''', she was the daughter of the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and Senator [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo]]. Her birth occurred in the aftermath of the [[Clone Wars]], which saw the [[Jedi Order]] [[Great Jedi Purge|purged]] and the [[Galactic Republic]] [[Proclamation of the New Order|reorganized]] into the [[Galaxy|Galactic]] Empire. With her [[Parent|mother's]] [[death]] in childbirth and her father's fall to the [[dark side of the Force]], Leia and her [[twin]] brother, [[Luke Skywalker|Luke]], were separated to keep them hidden from the hands of her father and the [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]]. As the adopted daughter of a politician, Leia grew up peacefully—albeit secluded—on Alderaan until she was kidnapped by mercenaries led by [[Vect Nokru]]—under the orders of the [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]], a member of the [[Inquisitorius]]—in [[9 BBY]]. Since he had fought alongside her adoptive father in the Clone Wars, [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] went to Leia's rescue on [[Daiyu]], and, after evading the Empire's hand on [[Mapuzo]] and [[Jabiim]], Leia was brought back to Alderaan. Years later, Leia succeeded Bail by representing their homeworld in the [[Imperial Senate]], though secretly she supported the Rebellion. During the [[Galactic Civil War]], however, Alderaan was [[Destruction of Alderaan|destroyed]] along with its inhabitants and the royal family by the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station]], causing Organa to openly fight the [[New Order]] as one of the Rebel Alliance’s substantial heroes.

In the aftermath of the [[Battle of Endor]], Organa [[Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa|married]] the [[Corellian]] [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] and learned the [[Jedi training|Jedi arts]] as her brother's [[Padawan|apprentice]] until giving birth to her son, [[Ben Solo]], on the [[Standard day|day]] of the Empire's [[Galactic Concordance|capitulation]] in [[5 ABY]]. Her personal and political life suffered in the [[Standard year|years]] that followed, with Ben turning to the dark side like his grandfather before him, adopting the persona of Kylo Ren, and the [[New Republic Senate|Galactic Senate]] sidelining Organa's career. Adopting the [[military rank]] of [[general]], she led the Resistance and their efforts to oppose the rising First Order during the [[Cold War]] while seeking to make amends with Ben in hopes that her son will return to the [[light side of the Force]] like her father during the Battle of Endor. Despite her efforts, the First Order succeeded in [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destroying]] the New Republic, and Organa's husband [[Battle of Starkiller Base|died]] at the hands of their estranged son in [[34 ABY]]. Organa continued to lead the Resistance during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the First Order, all the while passing on her Jedi training onto [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]]—a Force-sensitive [[scavenger]] from [[Jakku]] and Luke’s apprentice.

As her health declined, Organa used her remaining strength to reach her son, calling him back to the light side. Following her death on [[Ajan Kloss]] in [[35 ABY]], her final actions inspired Rey and the Resistance to [[Battle of Exegol|defeat]] the [[Final Order|forces]] of the [[Cloning|reborn]] Darth Sidious's [[Sith Eternal]] on [[Exegol]] and spark an [[uprising against the First Order]] across [[the galaxy]]. The heir to three inheritances, Leia Skywalker Organa Solo's legacy passed on to the Jedi Rey Skywalker, the military leader [[Poe Dameron]] of the Resistance, and Ben Solo, her only child, who ultimately returned to the light before sacrificing his life for Rey and becoming one with the Force to join his mother and the [[Skywalker family]].
